articles.title: Call Of Duty: MW4’s Campaign Launches Today, Please Don’t Spoil It For Others
articles.summary: It's a big day for Call of Duty, as Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4's campaign is playable beginning today, October 16, for people who preorder the game. The campaign is available to preload now, but doesn't unlock until 10 AM PT / 1 PM ET.
body: Developer Infinity Ward issued a statement, asking people to please not spoil the story. "We've one one ask. Let everyone experience it for themselves. Keep the campaign spoilers under wraps," Infinity Ward said. "Time to go dark."

MW4 is expected to wrap up the current Modern Warfare storyline that began with 2019's Modern Warfare. Activision boss Tyler Bahl told The Game Business that MW4 is the "epic conclusion of the recent series of Modern Warfare."

"It’s not that some characters and pieces can’t live on beyond this and be reinvented. But we’re excited by closing this chapter and launching a new one," he said. "Where we go with future games, we have to innovate."
To that end, Bahl also confirmed that a new sub-franchise for Call of Duty is in the works after years of Modern Warfare and Black Ops games.
points: It's a big day for Call of Duty, as Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4's campaign is playable beginning today, October 16, for people who preorder the game.

articles.title: The Blood Of Dawnwalker’s Next Update Will Let You Erase Your Mistakes And Pet The Dog
articles.summary: The Blood of Dawnwalker is already one of the best role-playing games of the year, but developer Rebel Wolves is preparing a big update that should make it even better. Like all good things in life, it starts with getting to pet a dog.
body: Update 1.1, which is scheduled to arrive next week, brings a number of new features to the game, including the ability to pet both dogs and cats via the game's directional system, which is currently only used for combat. It will also feature a new Story difficulty setting that provides "additional combat assist," new subtitle settings across all lines of dialogue, and most crucially, an item called Draught of Mind Rebirth.

The Draught of Mind Rebirth will allow you to forget all the skills and abilities you've acquired across the Swordmastery, Witchcraft, and Vampirism trees. Not only will this give you the chance to reallocate your points in a way that best fits your playstyle--it will also give you back the time associated with those skills. That means you'll have the chance to complete extra missions if you happen to find yourself impeded with Dawnwalker's 30-day limit. However, we don't find the system to be restrictive as it currently stands.
points: The Blood of Dawnwalker is already one of the best role-playing games of the year, but developer Rebel Wolves is preparing a big update that should make it even better.
Like all good things in life, it starts with getting to pet a dog.

articles.title: The Blood of Dawnwalker Update 1.1 Adds Directional Animal Petting and Over 1,100 Other Improvements and Fixes
articles.summary: Rebel Wolves really put out something special with The Blood of Dawnwalker, its vampire RPG where you straddle the line between monster and man. Now it’s getting even better with directional animal petting. Yeah, you heard.
body: Similar to Kingdom Come: Deliverance, Dawnwalker’s combat uses directional inputs to attack and defend from different angles during combat. Update 1.1, due out next week, will let you take that system and use it to frantically rub a dog.
“What happens when you merge a directional combat system with the ability to pet dogs and cats?” the studio asked. “Directional. Animal. Petting.”
The update also adds a consumable item: the Draught of Mind Rebirth. Take a sip and you’ll be able to respec all your upgrade points and try out a different build without starting the game again.

Elsewhere, the game is also getting an even easier mode for those who couldn’t get to grips with directional combat, as well as options for larger font sizes for the subtitles. Accessibility is always good.

articles.title: Next Red Dead Launching By 2027 Or 2028 “May Not Be Unreasonable,” Bank Says, But It Definitely Is
articles.summary: Citi, the investment bank and financial services company, has released a note about GTA 6 and Rockstar, and included in the brief is a line about what Rockstar could release next--a new Red Dead game.
body: The company said in its memo that, if Rockstar is telling the truth that GTA 6 did not in fact cost $1.5 billion to make, then the studio may be able to get a new Red Dead game out sooner than anyone might have imagined.
Citi said a new Red Dead game releasing in 2027 or 2028 "may not be unreasonable," according to Yahoo Finance.
The bank might be saying this, but it would be incredibly shocking, for a number of reasons, if a new Red Dead game releases as soon as next year.

There are historically years between major Rockstar releases, and even longer gaps between entries in the same series. For example, Red Dead Redemption launched in 2010, followed by GTA 5 in 2013, then Red Dead Redemption II in 2018, and now GTA 6 in 2026.

articles.title: iPhone Duo Preorders Are Live, But Shipping Is Already Pushed into 2027
articles.summary: If you’re planning to preorder an iPhone Duo, you’ll want to do so ASAP. The official release date is October 23, and preorders just began this morning. However, unless you’ve already locked in your preorder, you’ll have to wait several months to get your hands on Apple’s first foldable phone…
body: The iPhone Duo represents the most drastic change in form factor Apple has ever introduced in its smartphone lineup. Shaped basically like a passport, it’s made up of two ultra-thin panels. When folded, it has a 5.4-inch front screen you can use to access anything on your phone. But if you unfold it — which initiates an extremely cool animation — the device turns into a wide 7.6-inch display that’s basically the size of an iPad mini. It’s really cool.

Apple has adapted the iOS software for the new form factor as well. Instead of the dock being the bottom row of icons like on a standard iPhone, the dock is shifted to a vertical column on the right side of the display. This makes them easier to access with the wide form factor (for right-handed folks, anyway). You can also use apps in full-screen or use two apps side by side. Basically, any way you fold or unfold the device, iOS adapts.

The inner display uses wide-angle OLEDs, and has a 3,000-nit peak brightness. It also has a "nano-texture display" that Apple says helps minimize the appearance of any crease. That big, ultra-portable display just might make the iPhone Duo an excellent device for gaming.
points: If you’re planning to preorder an iPhone Duo, you’ll want to do so ASAP.

articles.title: This Anime Stalker Russian Roulette Game Is Afraid AI Copycats Will Steal Its Ideas
articles.summary: Developers have dealt with copycat games for many years, but generative AI has made it easier than ever to whip up a clone, and that problem has grown in recent years.
body: "We sincerely apologize for the short notice to everyone who was looking forward to it," the developer wrote online. "We're concerned that the demo's content could be used to quickly imitate or replicate the game's presentation and gameplay with AI or other tools, and that such works could be released before our launch."

Alliance Arts is also concerned that it can't properly manage restrictions on posting and streaming content from the game, and it'll instead hand out demo keys and collect feedback for the game through its group Discord. The studio's fears aren't unwarranted, with the upcoming Needle in a Haystack being a prime example of Steam's copycat problem. After the game was announced in August and a clip of its purposefully tedious gameplay went viral--you genuinely are just looking for a needle in a haystack--clones quickly popped up online.
A quick search on Steam reveals several games all with a similar theme, and these have been released within weeks of each other.

articles.title: The 'Father of PlayStation' Says Killing Discs Backlash Is a 'Mentality Issue'
articles.summary: Ken Kutaragi, known as "The Father of PlayStation," has backed Sony's controversial decision to scrap discs on PS5. Kutaragi, who ran Sony's gaming business through its first three console generations, told VGC that while he understands the backlash, it isn't “economically reasonable.” “Although we…
body: “Although we had network capability back in the PS2 and PS3 days, it was not that common [as it is today]. Now, many, many people are connected,” he said.

“I understand that physical discs have become a metaphor for ‘owning’ games. I really understand that mentality… But nobody thinks [physical media] is necessary for a networked device like a smartphone, for example, because people feel that they will keep their content. So it’s a mentality.
“I really understand [why some people are upset], but I don’t think it’s economically reasonable. Maybe it’s a mentality issue.”

While Kutaragi noted that Sony's decision had caused friction for players, he pointed at the makeup of Sony Interactive Entertainment, which employs people from streaming services such as Gaikai. Kutaragi noted that Sony might have ambitions wider than just gaming with its all-digital plans.

articles.summary: At the end of September, The Blood of Dawnwalker director Konrad Tomaszkiewicz revealed to Eurogamer that a big patch was in store for the vampire RPG. That massive update is finally on its way.
body: The developer revealed the highlights of the upcoming patch in a post on the game's official X account. It will introduce an even easier version of the game's current Story mode, while the existing Story mode will now be called Forgiving. The patch also adds Draught of Mind Rebirth, which essentially lets players reset all their unlocked abilities. The game will also get directional animal petting so you can finally make friends with all the dogs and cats in Vale Sangora.

The most glaring omission in the patch 1.1 feature list is New Game Plus, something fans have been asking for since the game's launch. Tomaszkiewicz has said the team is looking into the feature, but that he can't say anything yet. Rebel Wolves hasn't said exactly when the new patch will be released, or if it will come to all platforms at the same time.

articles.title: 'Pokémon TCG Pocket' Announces Big Update to Address Player Concerns
articles.summary: If you’ve played the mobile game Pokémon Trading Card Game Pocket, you probably have at least two major complaints: the UI is too slow, and the current card set release cadence is overwhelming. It seems that DeNa and The Pokémon Company are working on fixing at least one of these issues.
body: The Pokémon TCG Pocket Operations Team outlined additions and improvements coming to the game for its second anniversary. The biggest change is that new releases will come every six weeks instead of monthly.

While getting less content could be seen as a bad thing, TCG Pocket ​​​​'s rapid release schedule has overwhelmed many players. Whether you’re aiming to collect all the cards or trying to stay on top of the competitive meta, keeping up with the current release cycle requires near-religious devotion. The change to the game’s release calendar will start with the upcoming C series of card releases.

As for the deck-building experience, TCG Pocket is adding a Community Decks feature that lets you easily browse other players’ decks in-game and copy them. The developers are also attempting to improve the utility of rental decks and starter decks, giving them unlimited uses and making them available in versus play. Perhaps the most interesting addition to deck-building is Limited Battles, a new event type with a restricted card pool. These competitions will award players with accessories.
points: If you’ve played the mobile game Pokémon Trading Card Game Pocket, you probably have at least two major complaints: the UI is too slow, and the current card set release cadence is overwhelming.

articles.summary: You can smell it in the air can't you? Feel the chill in your nostrils and the earthy scent as leaves fall and the sun departs for another year? Yes, autumn is here, meaning we're teetering on the cavernous hole of near-nothingness as the entire games industry gives GTA 6 the widest berth…
body: I've been very excited about Bristol developer Friday Sundae's There are no Ghosts at the Grand ever since I saw it at a preview last year. It's one of those things that reads like a checklist of my very specific gaming interests, being part musical, part home renovation sim, and part ghostbusting mystery adventure, all unfolding in a dilapidated hotel in a British seaside town.

The idea is you've got 30 days to renovate it (exactly why is part of the mystery given its protagonist has motives so secret, he'll even try hiding them from the player), but there's plenty more to do besides: you can explore the cobblestone streets, go sailing out at sea, or take a scooter into the countryside as you attempt to uncover the truth about the hotel’s strange past. By night, there are ghosts to deal with - and throughout all this, the cast is prone to bursting into song. And if that tickles you fancy in the same way it's tickling mine, you can play a Steam demo right now ahead of its December arrival.

articles.title: Fortnite is coming to Linux so we may soon be able to play it and other games like Apex Legends on Steam Deck and Steam Machine
articles.summary: Epic Games is officially working on bringing its battle royale shooter Fortnite to Linux. The announcement was tucked away at the bottom of Epic's widely mocked blog post revealing the new, "vibe-coded" Epic Games Store, which is also coming to Linux.
body: At the time, Epic explained it's going to be working with Linux distro maintainers on a set of security requirements needed to run Fortnite. Distros - short for distributions - are operating system variants of Linux, each with its own goals and prioritised system operations. Valve's SteamOS, for instance, is based on Arch Linux. Because of the many discrepancies between Linux distros, each would need to implement Epic's security requirements individually if they want Fortnite to run on their operating system. Fortnite will arrive on Linux via the EGS launcher, but only if a "critical mass of distro maintainers" is reached. Epic didn't specify numbers.

This is big news for several reasons. For one, the move would likely make Fortnite playable on SteamOS PCs and handhelds, including Steam Machine and Steam Deck. Furthermore, even if that "critical mass" is never reached, Epic says its work will be available to other developers interested in bringing their games to Linux.
points: Epic Games is officially working on bringing its battle royale shooter Fortnite to Linux.

articles.title: Wardogs devs rush to fix XP exploit allowing players to quickly unlock tanks and stomp competition on Season 2's first day
articles.summary: The launch of a new live season is hard, and subtle changes to a game can have massive consequences when players get their hands on it. Wardogs proved this true with the launch of its second season this week, as players were able to unlock tanks on day one.
body: The good news (or bad, depending on whether you feel you've missed out on a head start) is that this exploit has already been fixed. Players could drive just outside of their HQ, drop off pallets, and return to base to earn a sizable amount of XP. This, paired with faster XP gains for the Driver role allowed people to ascend rapidly through the Driver progression track and unlock tanks.

This was a problem, as unlocking anti-tank equipment via other progression paths took far longer than the measly few hours of dedicated grinding these Driver XP exploiters sat through, meaning the vast majority of players were unprepared to deal with the tanks - unless they made use of the exploit themselves and got their own.

In a post made to the Wardogs Discord, Bulkhead co-founder Howard Philpott said: "We're holding our hands up and we got a few things wrong". He went on to explain that a backend update was being pushed through that fixes a progression bug for the driver XP path, stomps out that aforementioned exploit, and also removes the Lonestar (blue team) cash and XP bonuses.
points: The launch of a new live season is hard, and subtle changes to a game can have massive consequences when players get their hands on it.
Wardogs proved this true with the launch of its second season this week, as players were able to unlock tanks on day one.

videos.summary: Welcome back to Next-Gen Console Watch! This week Daemon is joined by fellow Omega Cop, Nick Limon, and Beyond's Nick Maillet to talk about that rumored GTA 6 on PC release window.
points: This week Daemon is joined by fellow Omega Cop, Nick Limon, and Beyond's Nick Maillet to talk about that rumored GTA 6 on PC release window.
Rockstar and Take-Two have officially been keeping quiet on GTA 6's PC release, but according to a new report, anonymous sources have stated a Q1 2027 release window.
That's only a few months after the PS5 and Xbox release, when usually Rockstar takes a year or more to port their big titles from console to PC.
And does it have anything to do with the rapid advancements in the PS5 AI recomp scene?
videos.author: IGN
